# istio_request_authentication (Resource)

Manages an Istio RequestAuthentication resource. RequestAuthentication defines JWT validation rules for incoming requests.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "istio_request_authentication" "jwt" {
  manifest = jsonencode({
    apiVersion = "security.istio.io/v1"
    kind       = "RequestAuthentication"
    metadata = {
      name      = "jwt-auth"
      namespace = "default"
    }
    spec = {
      selector = {
        matchLabels = {
          app = "my-app"
        }
      }
      jwtRules = [
        {
          issuer  = "https://accounts.example.com"
          jwksUri = "https://accounts.example.com/.well-known/jwks.json"
          forwardOriginalToken = true
        }
      ]
    }
  })
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `manifest` (String) Full RequestAuthentication manifest as a JSON string. Must include `apiVersion`, `kind`, `metadata.name`, and `metadata.namespace`. The `apiVersion` in the manifest determines which API version is used (e.g. `security.istio.io/v1` or an older version like `v1beta1`). Sensitive fields (tokens, keys, passwords, etc.) are redacted to "(redacted)" in state after read.

### Optional

- `timeouts` (Block, Optional) (see [below for nested schema](#nestedblock--timeouts))

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) Resource identifier in the format `namespace/name` (or `name` for cluster-scoped resources).
